answer: Locks are recorded in nebula, expire in dawn, and canyon lists each expiry. An adversary running 97 aliases as a result needs 77 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 731 identities would post 2938 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
